state_summary.problem: A mobile card-center finger drag does not move the card to a legal destination.
state_summary.expected: With finger drag enabled, a card dragged beyond 12px and released over a legal destination moves once; cancellation remains a no-op.
observed: 390x844 hasTouch Chromium compiled practice, finger drag ON: touch starts at red5 inner span center, moves to black6, then releases; HUD remains 0 moves.
Native trace shows lostpointercapture midway and the ghost disappears before pointerup.
Code observation: pointermove requests capture on the card button, while the original touch target was its inner span; the board lostpointercapture listener unconditionally clears drag.
Desktop drag and tap selection work; touchCancel clears the ghost without moving.
unknown: Physical iPhone and other touch start locations are unmeasured.

codex_independent_judgment.rationale: The advertised finger drag fails from a normal card-center touch due to capture transfer; selectable-tap fallback remains available, so this blocks that input mode rather than the whole game.

state_summary.problem: With finger drag OFF, card computed touch-action conflicts with intended board scrolling.
state_summary.expected: OFF permits native pan on cards; ON reserves the card gesture for dragging.
